children: Sabre, through subsidiary Sabre Financial, has terminated the indenture governing its 11.125% Senior Secured Notes due 2029 after completing a tender offer and redeeming the remainder on Oct 13, 2026. Holders tendered $931.6 million (93.16%) of the notes by the Oct 12 expiration, and the remaining $68.4 million was redeemed at 109.250% plus accrued interest. The indenture, dated Dec 5, 2025 with Wilmington Trust as trustee and collateral agent, was satisfied and discharged upon full repayment. The move reduces debt and simplifies the company’s capital structure.
